MATCH (d:Decision)-[:BASED_ON]->(f:Fact)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..]->(s:Source)
WHERE s.uri CONTAINS '02_api_style_guide_v1'
RETURN DISTINCT d.text AS text

WITH RECURSIVE edges(child, parent) AS (
  SELECT src, dst FROM fact_links WHERE kind LIKE 'DERIV%FROM%'
  UNION
  SELECT dst, src FROM fact_links WHERE kind IN ('DERIVES','DERIVES_INTO','SOURCE_OF')
),
tainted(fid) AS (
  SELECT fl.src FROM fact_links fl
  JOIN sources s ON s.id = fl.dst
  WHERE fl.kind <> 'BASED_ON' AND s.uri LIKE '%02_api_style_guide_v1%'
  UNION
  SELECT fl.dst FROM fact_links fl
  JOIN sources s ON s.id = fl.src
  WHERE fl.kind <> 'BASED_ON' AND s.uri LIKE '%02_api_style_guide_v1%'
  UNION
  SELECT e.child FROM edges e
  JOIN tainted t ON e.parent = t.fid
),
dec_ids(did) AS (
  SELECT df.decision_id FROM decision_facts df WHERE df.fact_id IN (SELECT fid FROM tainted)
  UNION
  SELECT fl.src FROM fact_links fl WHERE fl.kind = 'BASED_ON' AND fl.dst IN (SELECT fid FROM tainted)
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.text
FROM decisions d
WHERE d.id IN (SELECT did FROM dec_ids)

MATCH (s:Step)-[r:READ]->(f:Fact)
WHERE f.value IN $old AND s.at < $t AND coalesce(r.via, 'recall') = 'recall'
MATCH (s)-[:BY]->(a:Agent)
RETURN DISTINCT a.id AS agent_id

SELECT DISTINCT s.agent_id
FROM steps s
JOIN step_reads sr ON sr.step_id = s.id
JOIN facts f ON f.id = sr.fact_id
WHERE f.value IN ({old})
  AND s.at < :t

MATCH (t:Task {status: 'done'})<-[:FOR]-(a:Artifact)
MATCH (f:Fact)
WHERE f.value STARTS WITH 'AX-'
  AND f.valid_to <= t.done_at
  AND a.summary CONTAINS f.value
RETURN DISTINCT t.id

SELECT DISTINCT t.id
FROM tasks t
JOIN artifacts a ON a.task_id = t.id
JOIN facts f ON f.value LIKE 'AX-%'
             AND instr(a.summary, f.value) > 0
WHERE t.status = 'done'
  AND f.valid_to <= t.done_at

MATCH (s:Source)
WHERE s.uri CONTAINS '02_api_style_guide_v1'
MATCH (f:Fact)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..]->(s)
WITH DISTINCT f
MATCH (d:Decision)-[:BASED_ON]->(f)
RETURN DISTINCT d.text

WITH RECURSIVE d(id) AS (
  SELECT fl.src FROM fact_links fl
  JOIN sources s ON (s.id = fl.dst OR s.uri = fl.dst)
  WHERE fl.kind LIKE 'DERIV%' AND instr(s.uri, '02_api_style_guide_v1') > 0
  UNION
  SELECT fl.dst FROM fact_links fl
  JOIN sources s ON (s.id = fl.src OR s.uri = fl.src)
  WHERE fl.kind LIKE 'DERIV%' AND instr(s.uri, '02_api_style_guide_v1') > 0
  UNION
  SELECT fl.src FROM fact_links fl
  JOIN d ON fl.dst = d.id
  WHERE fl.kind LIKE 'DERIV%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT dec.text
FROM decisions dec
JOIN decision_facts df ON df.decision_id = dec.id
WHERE df.fact_id IN (SELECT id FROM d)

MATCH (s:Step)-[r:READ]->(f:Fact)
WHERE f.value IN $old AND s.at < $t AND coalesce(r.via, 'recall') = 'recall'
MATCH (s)-[:BY]->(a:Agent)
RETURN DISTINCT a.id

SELECT DISTINCT s.agent_id
FROM steps s
JOIN step_reads sr ON sr.step_id = s.id
JOIN facts f ON f.id = sr.fact_id
WHERE f.value IN ({old})
  AND s.at < :t

MATCH (a:Artifact)-[:FOR]->(t:Task {status: 'done'})
MATCH (f:Fact)
WHERE f.value STARTS WITH 'AX-'
  AND f.valid_to <= t.done_at
  AND a.summary CONTAINS f.value
RETURN DISTINCT t.id AS id

SELECT DISTINCT t.id
FROM tasks t
JOIN artifacts a ON a.task_id = t.id
JOIN facts f ON f.value LIKE 'AX-%'
  AND f.valid_to <= t.done_at
  AND instr(a.summary, f.value) > 0
WHERE t.status = 'done'

MATCH (d:Decision)-[:BASED_ON]->(f:Fact)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..10]->(s:Source)
WHERE s.uri CONTAINS '02_api_style_guide_v1'
RETURN DISTINCT d.text

WITH RECURSIVE d(id) AS (
  SELECT fl.src
  FROM fact_links fl
  JOIN sources s ON s.id = fl.dst
  WHERE instr(s.uri, '02_api_style_guide_v1') > 0
  UNION
  SELECT fl.src
  FROM fact_links fl
  JOIN d ON fl.dst = d.id
  WHERE fl.kind = 'DERIVED_FROM'
)
SELECT DISTINCT dec.text
FROM decisions dec
JOIN decision_facts df ON df.decision_id = dec.id
WHERE df.fact_id IN (SELECT id FROM d)

MATCH (s:Step)-[r:READ]->(f:Fact)
WHERE f.value IN $old AND s.at < $t AND coalesce(r.via, 'recall') = 'recall'
MATCH (s)-[:BY]->(a:Agent)
RETURN DISTINCT a.id AS agent_id

SELECT DISTINCT s.agent_id
FROM steps s
JOIN step_reads r ON r.step_id = s.id
JOIN facts f ON f.id = r.fact_id
WHERE f.value IN ({old})
  AND s.at < :t

MATCH (t:Task {status: 'done'})<-[:FOR]-(a:Artifact)
MATCH (f:Fact)
WHERE f.value STARTS WITH 'AX-'
  AND f.valid_to <= t.done_at
  AND a.summary CONTAINS f.value
RETURN DISTINCT t.id

SELECT DISTINCT t.id
FROM tasks t
JOIN artifacts a ON a.task_id = t.id
JOIN facts f ON f.value LIKE 'AX-%'
  AND f.valid_to <= t.done_at
  AND instr(a.summary, f.value) > 0
WHERE t.status = 'done'
